<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN"><body><title>VIP 升级｜舒苑2027奇门遁甲战略大会</title><meta property="og:title" content="VIP 升级｜舒苑2027奇门遁甲战略大会"><meta property="og:description" content="报名成功。原价 RM3,005，现在升级 VIP 只需 RM97。"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;700;900&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--red:#D03F58;--redtext:#B83349;--deep:#9B2C41;--beige:#EFDFB3;--ink:#3B1424;--muted:#6b5a5d;--canvas:#FBF6E8}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:"Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--canvas);line-height:1.75}
header{padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #eadfc0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#fff}
header img{height:40px;width:auto}header b{font-size:15px}
.done{background:var(--ink);color:var(--beige);text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 16px}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#D03F58,#9B2C41);color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:52px 20px 92px}
.kick{display:inline-block;border:1px solid rgba(239,223,179,.6);color:var(--beige);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em}
h1{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:34px;line-height:1.3;margin:18px auto 14px;max-width:680px}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--beige)}
.hero p{max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;color:#FFF6E4;font-size:17px}
.wrap{max-width:780px;margin:-56px auto 0;padding:0 18px 48px}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(120,40,50,.12);margin-bottom:20px}
.qs{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.qs li{background:var(--canvas);border-left:4px solid var(--red);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin:10px 0;font-weight:500}
h2{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:24px;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.4}
.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 6px}
.ben{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid #f0e6cc}
.ben:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.no{flex:0 0 46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--beige);color:var(--deep);font-weight:900;font-size:17px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ben h3{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.45}
.ben strong{display:block;color:var(--redtext);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:4px}
.ben p{margin:0;color:#4a3338;font-size:15.5px}
.sum{background:var(--canvas);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px;color:#4a3338;font-size:15.5px}
.price{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#D03F58,#9B2C41);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:30px 24px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(120,40,50,.18);margin-bottom:20px}
.price .lbl{color:var(--beige);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;font-size:20px;line-height:1.4}
.price .amt{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:56px;line-height:1.1;margin:8px 0 4px;color:#fff}
.price .amt small{font-size:22px;margin-right:6px}
.price p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#FFF6E4}
.btn{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--beige);color:var(--ink);font-weight:900;font-size:19px;padding:17px 20px;border-radius:14px;text-decoration:none;margin-top:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(59,20,36,.25)}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(.97)}
.once{font-size:14px;color:#FFF6E4;margin-top:14px}
.price .skip,.hero .skip,.vsx-sum .skip{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.skip{display:block;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin:6px auto 0;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.vid{max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 20px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#2a0f18;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(120,40,50,.18)}
.vid [data-aigoal-video]{position:relative;aspect-ratio:9/16;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--beige);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.vcap{text-align:center;color:var(--crimson,#C0394F);font-weight:800;font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;margin:-8px 0 22px}
.pain h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.pl{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:14px 0}
.pl i{flex:0 0 26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#F6E3E7;color:var(--red);font-style:normal;font-weight:900;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;margin-top:3px}
.pl p{margin:0;font-size:16px}
.turn{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px dashed #e6d6ae;font-weight:700;font-size:17px}
.turn em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.hl{color:var(--beige);font-size:20px}
.hb{max-width:420px;margin:24px auto 0}
.hero .once{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;color:#FFF6E4}
.mini{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #eadfc0;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;margin:0 0 22px}
.mini b{display:block;color:var(--redtext);font-size:17px}.mini span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.mini a{flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-weight:900;text-decoration:none;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 18px}
.vbtn{max-width:420px;margin:0 auto}
.btn.red{background:var(--red);color:#fff;margin-top:18px}
.sum b{color:var(--redtext)}
.sticky{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--ink);padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.sticky span{color:var(--beige);font-size:14px;font-weight:700}.sticky span b{font-size:20px;margin-left:8px;color:#fff}
.sticky a{background:var(--beige);color:var(--ink);font-weight:900;text-decoration:none;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 18px}
.prog{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #eadfc0;padding:14px 18px 12px}
.pin{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.ptop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.ptop b{color:var(--red);font-size:15px}
.track{height:12px;border-radius:99px;background:#F3E9CF;overflow:hidden}
.track i{display:block;height:100%;width:90%;border-radius:99px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#D03F58 0 14px,#C2344D 14px 28px);background-size:40px 40px;animation:pmove 1.2s linear infinite}
@keyframes pmove{from{background-position:0 0}to{background-position:40px 0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.track i{animation:none}}
.psteps{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:9px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.psteps span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.psteps em{font-style:normal;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;background:#F3E9CF;color:var(--muted)}
.psteps .ok em{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.psteps .cur{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}.psteps .cur em{background:var(--beige);color:var(--deep);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--red)}
footer{padding-bottom:90px}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;padding:8px 20px 40px}
@media(max-width:560px){h1{font-size:27px}.price .amt{font-size:46px}.card{padding:22px 18px}}

.ptop b{color:var(--red)}
.pleft{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.ticker{overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);color:var(--beige);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:10px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker .tk{display:inline-block;animation:tk 22s linear infinite}
.ticker span{display:inline-block;padding:0 22px}
.ticker span b{color:#fff}
.ticker .tkw{display:inline-flex;vertical-align:-3px;color:#F3C64F}
@keyframes tk{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ticker .tk{animation:none}}
.hero{padding:34px 20px 70px}
.hero .big{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:40px;line-height:1.15;margin:12px auto 10px;color:#fff}
.hero .big em{font-style:normal;color:var(--beige)}
.hero p{font-size:16.5px}
.bl{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.bl li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin:10px 0;font-size:16px}
.bl li:before{content:"";flex:0 0 8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);margin-top:9px}
.ben{padding:14px 0}
.ben h3{font-size:17px}
.ben p{font-size:14.5px}
.no{flex:0 0 38px;height:38px;font-size:15px}
.card{padding:22px 20px}
h2{font-size:21px}
footer{padding-bottom:28px}
@media(max-width:560px){.hero .big{font-size:32px}}

.prog{padding:16px 18px 16px}
.track{height:34px;border-radius:99px;background:#F3E9CF;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(59,20,36,.12)}
.track i{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding-right:14px}
.track i b{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25);font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.02em}
.ptop{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px}

.vs{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #f0e6cc}
.vs:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.vt{flex:1;min-width:0}.vt h3{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.4}.vt p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:#4a3338}
.vp{flex:0 0 auto;font-weight:900;color:var(--redtext);font-size:17px;white-space:nowrap;padding-top:2px}
.vtotal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:2px dashed #e6d6ae;margin-top:6px;padding-top:14px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.vtotal s{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted)}
.vtoday{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--canvas);border:2px solid var(--red);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;margin-top:10px;font-weight:700}
.vtoday b{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-size:30px;color:var(--red);line-height:1}
.track{position:relative}
.track .pct{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap}
.vimg{flex:0 0 104px;width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:16px;object-fit:contain}
.vs:last-of-type .vimg{object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(59,20,36,.18)}
@media(max-width:400px){.vimg{flex-basis:92px;width:92px;height:92px}}
.vh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}.vh h3{flex:1}
.vid{margin-top:84px!important;max-width:820px!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:18px}
.vid [data-aigoal-video]{aspect-ratio:auto!important;padding:0!important}
.vid [data-aigoal-player]{margin:0 auto!important;max-width:none!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(120,40,50,.2)}
@media(min-width:900px){.wrap{max-width:900px}}

.vsx{margin:28px -18px 24px;border-radius:0;overflow:hidden;background:#FBF3E0}
.vsx-head{text-align:center;padding:34px 20px 22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FBF3E0,#F4E3BC)}
.vsx-head small{display:block;letter-spacing:.32em;font-size:12px;color:#9B2C41;font-weight:700}
.vsx-head h2{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:34px;margin:6px 0 4px;color:#3B1424;letter-spacing:.04em}
.vsx-head p{margin:0;color:#6b4a4f;font-size:15px}
.feat{position:relative;padding:30px 20px 26px;background:radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 35%,#FFF7E4 0%,#F6E4BD 55%,#E9CF95 100%)}
.feat.dark{background:radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 35%,#7A2337 0%,#4A1424 60%,#2A0B15 100%);color:#fff}
.fhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.fno{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:900;font-size:86px;line-height:.8;color:#3B1424;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.feat.dark .fno{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF1C9,#D9AE5C);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.fhead small{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#9B2C41;letter-spacing:.06em}
.feat.dark .fhead small{color:#EFDFB3}
.fhead h3{margin:2px 0 0;font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;color:#3B1424}
.feat.dark .fhead h3{color:#fff}
.fimg{display:block;width:100%;max-width:280px;margin:4px auto 16px;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 28px rgba(59,20,36,.35))}
.fimg.wide{border-radius:16px;filter:none;box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.fbody{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px}
.feat.dark .fbody{background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.fbody p{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;color:#3B1424}
.feat.dark .fbody p{color:#FFF6E4}
.fbody b{font-weight:900}
.feat.dark .fbody b{color:#F3D58C}
.fval{margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;color:#9B2C41;font-weight:700}
.feat.dark .fval{color:#EFDFB3}
.fval .vp{font-size:22px;margin-left:6px;font-weight:900}
.vsx-sum{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2A0B15,#4A1424);color:#fff;padding:28px 22px 30px}
.vsx-sum .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(239,223,179,.3);font-size:15.5px;color:#FFF6E4}
.vsx-sum .row b{color:#FFF6E4}
.vsx-sum .vsx-h{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:32px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:900;color:#fff;text-align:center}
.vsx-sum .vsx-h em{font-style:normal;color:#EFDFB3;display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
@media(min-width:701px){.vsx-sum .vsx-h{font-size:44px}}
.vsx-sum .tot{font-weight:900;font-size:17px;border-bottom:0;padding-top:14px}
.vsx-sum .tot s{color:#EFDFB3;font-size:22px}
.today{margin:14px 0 4px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF1C9,#E3BE6E);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;color:#3B1424}
.today small{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.today b{display:block;font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:62px;line-height:1.05;color:#B83349}
.today b em{font-style:normal;font-size:26px;margin-right:4px}
.vsx-sum .btn.red{margin-top:16px}
@media(min-width:700px){.vsx{margin:28px 0 24px;border-radius:24px}.feat{padding:40px 44px 34px}.fno{font-size:110px}.fhead h3{font-size:34px}}

.hero .pain{font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:44px;line-height:1.2;margin:14px 0 10px;color:#fff}
.hero .pain em{font-style:normal;color:var(--beige)}
.deal{margin:22px auto 6px;max-width:420px;background:#FFF7E4;border-radius:22px;padding:18px 16px 16px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(42,8,18,.35);position:relative}
.deal .was{font-size:17px;color:#6b5a5d;font-weight:700}.deal .was s{font-size:22px;color:#9B2C41;text-decoration-thickness:3px}
.deal .now small{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.deal .now b{display:block;font-family:"Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:900;font-size:84px;line-height:1;color:#D03F58}
.deal .now b em{font-style:normal;font-size:32px;margin-right:4px}
.deal .save{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;background:#D03F58;color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:15px;border-radius:99px;padding:5px 16px}
.btn s{opacity:.65;font-weight:700;margin-right:4px;text-decoration-thickness:2px}
.was2{color:#FFE9C4;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px}.was2 s{font-size:22px}
.was3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#7a4a50}.was3 s{font-size:20px}
.vsx-head h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#D03F58}
.vsx-head h2{font-size:36px;line-height:1.25}
@media(max-width:400px){.hero .pain{font-size:38px}.deal .now b{font-size:74px}}

.hero{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;text-align:center!important}
.hero .pain{text-align:center!important;margin:20px auto 16px!important;font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,64px)!important;width:100%}
.hero > p{text-align:center!important;margin:0 auto 4px!important;font-size:clamp(16.5px,1.6vw,19px)!important}
.hero .deal,.hero .hb{width:100%!important;max-width:480px!important;box-sizing:border-box}
.kick{font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,20px)!important;padding:8px 22px!important;font-weight:800!important;background:rgba(59,15,24,.25);color:#EFDFB3!important}

[data-aigoal-wa]{display:none!important}

[data-aigoal-modal]{display:none!important;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9998;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(42,20,24,.62)}
[data-aigoal-modal].ag-open{display:flex!important}
body:has(.vmodal.ag-open){overflow:hidden}
.vm-card{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:460px;max-height:calc(100vh - 32px);overflow:auto;background:#FFF9EC;border-radius:24px;padding:30px 24px 24px;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(42,20,24,.4);text-align:center;color:#2A1418}
.vm-x{position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#EFDFB3;color:#5E4A4C;font-size:26px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.vm-x:hover{color:#D03F58}
.vm-kick{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#B83349}
.vm-card h2{margin:8px 0 18px;font-size:24px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:900}
.vm-list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0;text-align:left;display:grid;gap:8px}
.vm-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.vm-list s{color:#8a6b6f;font-weight:600}
.vm-total{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin:6px 0 16px}
.vm-total span{font-size:14px;color:#5E4A4C}.vm-total b{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#D03F58}
.vm-pay{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;font-size:18px}
.vm-skip{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#8E2438;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.vm-note{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#5E4A4C}
@media(max-width:600px){[data-aigoal-modal]{align-items:flex-end;padding:0}.vm-card{max-width:none;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;max-height:92vh}}

.fnote{margin:6px 0 0!important;font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.5;color:#8a6b6f!important;font-weight:500}

/* aigoal embedded checkout modal: visible close + loading + full screen mobile */
@keyframes agSpin2{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
[data-aigoal-pay-modal] [role=dialog]>button[aria-label=Close]{position:fixed!important;float:none!important;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))!important;right:12px!important;z-index:2147483600!important;width:44px;height:44px;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center;border-radius:50%!important;background:#2A1418!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:28px!important;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
[data-aigoal-pay-modal] [role=dialog]>div>div[style*="padding: 90px"]{font-size:0!important;color:transparent!important;position:relative}
[data-aigoal-pay-modal] [role=dialog]>div>div[style*="padding: 90px"]::before{content:"";display:block;width:40px;height:40px;margin:0 auto 18px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #EFDFB3;border-top-color:#D03F58;animation:agSpin2 .8s linear infinite}
[data-aigoal-pay-modal] [role=dialog]>div>div[style*="padding: 90px"]::after{content:"正在打开安全付款页…";display:block;font:700 16px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;color:#2A1418}
[data-aigoal-pay-modal] [role=dialog]>div>div[style*="185, 28, 28"]{font-size:15px!important;color:#b91c1c!important}
